verdict.rationale: The Venture & Growth Tech page explicitly documents 'from fundraising to exit,' seed-to-IPO financing support, and an M&A section with a concrete deal reference (Comeen/LumApps), plus a Chambers Band 1 ranking for VC deals. However, evidence of public-offering (IPO) experience is only a passing mention ('seed capital to IPOs') with no dedicated IPO track record, case studies, or named public-offering deals, and no independent corroboration beyond the firm's own award blurb. Missing for 10: dedicated IPO/public-offering case studies or league-table rankings, named large-scale exit transactions, independent press coverage of exits.
